criteria.evidence: Simple text prompt interface. Easy to start, accessible to beginners.
criteria.rationale: Most user-friendly system tested. Natural language interface.

criteria.evidence: 40-45 seconds for 30s output. Acceptable for creative workflow.
criteria.rationale: Slower than DDSP but still workable.

criteria.evidence: Compression artifacts present in all outputs. Acceptable quality but noticeable degradation.
criteria.rationale: Good but not excellent. Artifacts are limitation.

criteria.evidence: Mood-based prompting very effective. 'Dark', 'minimal', 'lo-fi', 'vintage' keywords accurate.
criteria.rationale: Excellent stylistic control via natural language.

criteria.evidence: Temperature and top-k work well. BPM/key control is approximate, not precise.
criteria.rationale: Good for mood/style, poor for technical precision.

criteria.evidence: Hard to isolate single instruments. System adds unrequested elements. Needed Demucs for separation.
criteria.rationale: Weak point. Multi-element blending is common.

criteria.evidence: Manual tempo warping needed (BPM imprecise). Otherwise integrates well.
Excellent for iterative layering. Felt like collaboration. 100% usable output rate in ambient session.
criteria.rationale: Best creative workflow experience. Inspiring and productive.

synthesis.top_strengths: Easy to use, excellent stylistic control, great creative workflow, versatile across genres
synthesis.top_weaknesses: Compression artifacts, imprecise BPM/key control, difficulty isolating single instruments
synthesis.standout_feature: Mood-based prompting works better than technical parameters - counter-intuitive but powerful
synthesis.best_suited_for: Texture generation, ideation, ambient music, layering building blocks, mood-based composition
synthesis.not_recommended_for: Precise rhythm programming, single instrument isolation, final production audio quality
synthesis.ideal_user_profile: Creative musicians who value inspiration and ease over technical precision

entries.one_line_summary: Productive ambient track creation with layering approach
